title: Land Rover Raided BYD's Offices. Then a Judge Stepped In #shorts

scenes.text: Land Rover says a Chinese SUV copied its Defender. So court officers raided the offices of BYD.
It's the BYD Ti7, a boxy plug-in hybrid. In Britain, it's about twenty thousand pounds cheaper than a seven-seat Defender.
In August, they seized files from two BYD offices in the Netherlands. Land Rover suspects BYD took a Defender apart.
Then the twist. A Dutch judge ordered Land Rover to destroy or hand back those files, or pay fifty thousand euros an hour.
The judge said those files weren't needed for the copying claim. That case goes on, and nothing is proven yet.
Real copy, or just another boxy off-roader? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
